description: Synthetic-customer W0: the MX run driven by ces-tester on the stacksim scenario s1-mach (S1, a fictional 45-person machining subcontractor on GCC High G5: 9 enforcing Conditional Access policies, Intune baseline and BitLocker, 3 DLP policies, Azure Government enclave; PLAN.md section 2.1). Steps as muster-partial-e2e.json. expected_facts are authored from the S1 shape and are PENDING reconciliation with the simulator's own expectedFacts (tenant-stacksim scenarios/s1-mach.json, not yet built when this file was written); expected_state and expected_ledger reuse the muster-partial checks for the settings Stamper writes on any tenant. Synthetic-customer W2: E7A runs three AdminOps ops (A-11 stale-account read, A-02 offboarding of the leaver whose account is still enabled, A-09 PIM role review read); E7B expects no status move (every control these ops map to is already met on S1, and B-07 is a no-op here because both compliant-device CA policies are already enabled), so those three move nothing. W7-TST: E7A also runs A-21 (leaver lifecycle workflow scheduling, T2, confirming read of the workflow's isSchedulingEnabled; resources.leaver_workflow_id discovered at E5), so expected_improvements is exactly PS.L2-3.9.2 not_met -> met (V47, V65); expected_ledger.mutated gains the leaver workflow (lifecycleWorkflows/51510000-001f-4000-8000-000000000003); ao_coverage.expected_total is 96 (the ces-ao registry gained A-21).

checks.description: Teams external federation access disabled on the Global policy (the base seed has it enabled)
Remote-maintenance MFA: S1's own all-users MFA policy is verified as the equivalent (W5 cycle 3 lookup; no CES policy created)

adminops_ops.description: Stale account detection (read). AO binds operatorUPN and breakGlassUPN from resources.operator_upn and resources.breakglass_upn (copied from the TM at E5).
User offboarding (disable) of the leaver whose account is still enabled: resources.offboard_upn, discovered at E5 from the sim (employeeLeaveDateTime passed, accountEnabled true).

confirm.description: AdminOps A-02: the leaver's account is disabled

adminops_ops.description: Privileged role review (PIM eligibility schedules for the Global, Privileged Role and Security Administrator roles). AO binds the role ids from resources.global_admin_role_def_id, else the built-in template ids.

W7-TST: leaver lifecycle workflow scheduling (PS.L2-3.9.2). resources.leaver_workflow_id is discovered at E5 from the sim: the enabled leaver workflow with a disable/delete-user-account task (S1 Leaver - disable account and remove access, 51510000-001f-4000-8000-000000000003, on demand in the seed). AO turns its scheduling on (the mover is already scheduled: no change); the op fails unless the bound id is such a leaver.

confirm.description: AdminOps A-21: the leaver workflow is scheduled
